name: Tomato Sauce
ingredients: Concentrated Tomatoes (Contains 126g of Tomatoes per 100g or 19g of Tomatoes per 15g serve), Sugar, Salt, Food Acid (Acetic Acid), Spices, Natural Flavours. Contains 81% Concentrated Tomatoes.
storage: TRANSFER PRODUCT INTO A CLEAN AND DRY NON-METALLIC CONTAINER AND KEEP REFRIGERATED.
origin: MADE IN NEW ZEALAND FROM IMPORTED AND LOCAL INGREDIENTS
note: Servings per package printed 'Approx. 38' at 15 g. No net weight is printed on either photographed face, so pack is unrecorded rather than inferred from 38 x 15. The '126g of Tomatoes per 100g' and '81%' figures were re-read from a native-resolution crop. Barcode wraps round the can: only '…400547 00739…' is legible, missing both the leading digit and the check digit, so no gtin is recorded. No allergen statement on the panel. 'PX23993/J' beside the barcode is a batch code.
